title: Validate App runtime helper seam extraction
description: Validate AppDelegate/AppLifecycle/runtime helper changes and ensure the extraction keeps lifecycle, pinned text, screenshot, and debug automation behavior explicit and test-covered.
action: Verify the App runtime seam extraction without expanding AppDelegate responsibilities. AppLifecyclePlanTests and AppRuntimeHelpersTests must pass. Keep all changes compatible with the existing ServiceContainer and AppDelegateLiveDependencies patterns.
implementation: Read AppDelegate, AppLifecyclePlan, AppRuntimeHelpers, and their tests before editing.
Run cd spoke && swift test --filter AppLifecyclePlanTests.
Run cd spoke && swift test --filter AppRuntimeHelpersTests.
If tests fail, fix only direct lifecycle/runtime helper mismatches and rerun the failed command.
Confirm no new runtime helper introduces unrelated product behavior.

criteria: cd spoke && swift test --filter AppLifecyclePlanTests exits 0
cd spoke && swift test --filter AppRuntimeHelpersTests exits 0
